name: Gain - ( G = 20 · log ₁₀( V_out / V_in ))

map.在线性放大倍数与分贝标度之间双向转换：dB = 20·log₁₀(A)（电压）或: Bidirectional conversion between linear amplification factor and decibel scale: dB = 20·log10(A) for voltage or 10·log10(A) for power.
map.放大器或网络的电压增益用分贝表示。: Express the voltage gain of an amplifier or network in decibels.
map.输出/输入电压比取 20log10 得增益。: Taking 20log10 of the output/input voltage ratio gives the gain.
map.增益 G = 20×log10(10/1) = 20 dB，即 10 倍电压放大: Gain G = 20xlog10(10/1) = 20 dB, i.e. a 10x voltage amplification.
map.若 vout=0.5、vin=1，则 G = 20×log10(0.5) ≈ −: If vout=0.5, vin=1, then G = 20xlog10(0.5) ~ -6.02 dB (about half voltage).
map.增益 dB 与功率 dB 一致吗？: Does gain dB agree with power dB?
map.在等阻抗下一致（电压平方=功率），否则需分别用 20log 与 10log。: They agree under equal impedance (voltage squared = power); otherwise use 20log and 10log separately.
map.0dB 表示 vout=vin，即单位增益、无放大也无衰减。: 0dB means vout=vin, i.e. unity gain, no amplification and no attenuation.
